# 90% prediction intervals at 72 h and 168 h: single test evaluation (generated by `scripts/run_long_intervals.py`)

Git commit `8bb5a29873`. Calibration on validation only (and, for the rolling variant, known past errors). PICP = share of hours inside the interval (nominal 90%); width in MW; interval score (lower is better). Demand growth and distribution shift make validation-calibrated intervals under-cover.
